payout_quote: Join + Get up to $300. Get $300 when you open a new checking account and set up a monthly direct deposit totaling $1,000 or more for two consecutive months. Get $150 when you open a new checking account and set up a monthly direct deposit totaling at least $500 for two consecutive months. Must be new checking relationship. Incentive deposited within 30 days of meeting direct deposit requirement. Cannot be combined with any other offer.
steps: Join Financial Plus Credit Union (serves all of Michigan; 13 locations)
Open a new checking account (Free Checking or Go-To Checking); must be a new checking relationship with the credit union
Set up monthly direct deposit: $1,000 or more per month for two consecutive months earns $300; $500 or more per month for two consecutive months earns $150
The incentive is deposited into the account within 30 days of meeting the direct deposit requirement
catches: Must be a new checking relationship - existing checking customers are excluded
Requires sustained direct deposit: $1,000+/month (or $500+/month for the $150 tier) for two consecutive months
Cannot be combined with any other Financial Plus offer
No minimum balance required on the checking account
biggest_catch: You need a real payroll direct deposit of $1,000/month (or $500/month for the lower tier) for two straight months - not just a one-time transfer.
eligibility: New checking customers only (new checking relationship); Michigan field of membership.
timing: Two consecutive months of qualifying monthly direct deposit; incentive paid within 30 days of meeting the requirement.
